slug: 2026-06-23 Bimonthly Update on Privacy in Africa (January & February 2026)

facts.fact: Tech Hive Advisory reports that Algeria's DPA issued a decision in January or February 2026 on handling employee and candidate drug test results.

Tech Hive Advisory reports a DPA decision, in the January and February 2026 period, that positive or negative test results alone are standard health data not sensitive data, so employers need no prior authorisation.
